label: second copy step (output orig token 1) in long sequences (L=9, some L=8)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost exclusively at the step right after the first copy output (prev_tok is <DEL>, input is orig(0), output is orig(1); recall_idx==1 holds 99.9% of activation mass). Strongly gated by sequence length: 88% of mass at L=9 (t=10), 11% at L=8, rare at L=7, never at L<=6. Within L=9 it fires on ~62% of sequences; magnitude and firing rate depend on the first original token (being fed back as input): highest for z, 1, 2, q, y, x, t, 0 (precision ~0.85-0.96), lowest for d, f, i, p (~0.1-0.16); excluding those raises F1 only slightly (0.70->0.74). More digits among originals increases rate. Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, or at recall_idx 0 or >=3.
